title: farbicfuse
description: in farbicfuse everytime you break an block tnt spawns
body:
so in this mod everytime you break a block an ignited tnt will spawn
also this mod was made because of a youtube video idea this mod was going to be an private mod but because this the only mod that uses 1.20.1 and i have not seen any other explosive mod that supports this verison so if you are making an modpack of 1.20.1 you can use this mod
also my channel is called kristo ISF
